I5.quote: The aim of this study was to synthesize the single walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) and determine their hydrogen storage capacities.

notes: I4 judgement: the sole area value (100 m2/g, main p. 2, II.A) describes the MgO support powder of the precursor; the paper reports no measurement on that powder and gives no area for the SWCNT samples. The Introduction mentions that microwave digestion can 'increase the surface area' (p. 1) without a value. Characterisation is TEM, Raman and TGA only. Not retracted (is_retracted false; no retraction notice in PDF). Primary article, English, no duplicate-data statement. Table II values (0.41-3.70 wt% at 77 K, 1 and 100 bar) are volumetric (HPVA-100) on purified SWCNTs.
